rows.falsifier: Fresh model invocations fail to maintain state continuity or exhibit uncontrolled deviation even when bound by explicit state verification architectures.
rows.reason: Evidence demonstrates that autonomous agents require explicit verification state architectures and substrate proportionality to maintain accountability across multi-turn trajectories, reinforced by findings on autonomous agent risks.
rows.statement: Fresh model invocations can function as a singular, accountable process when bound by verifiable state architectures and substrate-appropriate update mechanisms.
